q: How is my data kept private?
a: Your privacy is our priority. All entries are encrypted, and your journal stays local unless you choose to back it up.

q: Can I organize or search through my entries?
a: Definitely. Tag entries, add them to collections, and use filters or search to quickly revisit your past thoughts.

q: What’s the purpose of mood tagging?
a: Mood tags help you track emotional trends and patterns, offering insights into your well-being over time.

q: Can I use MuseLog on my phone?
a: Yes! MuseLog is fully responsive and works seamlessly on mobile, tablet, and desktop. A native app is on our roadmap too!
